payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the interfaces currently implemented for Macaw, including their functionalities and types.

claims.text: Macaw currently has three main interfaces: File IO, Standard IO, and a Telegram bot.
The Standard IO is an interactive command line interface for development purposes, while the Telegram bot allows multi-modal interactions with users.
The Telegram interface supports various devices and operating systems, enabling text, speech, image, and click interactions.
